import numpy as np

def grounded({{sentences}}, {{sources}}, {{embed_fn}}, {{threshold}}=0.6):
    src_e = [{{embed_fn}}(s) for s in {{sources}}]
    flags = []
    for sent in {{sentences}}:
        e = {{embed_fn}}(sent)
        sims = [np.dot(e, se)/(np.linalg.norm(e)*np.linalg.norm(se)) for se in src_e]
        flags.append(max(sims) >= {{threshold}})
    return flags
